product.title: Evac+Chair 220-ME Evac+Sled Evacuation Sled
product.body_html:
The Evac+Sled patient evacuation sled from Evac+Chair helps you prepare your patients for evacuation.  Designed for quick and easy use, this medical transport sled allows one person to safely transport another in emergencies, such as fires, tornadoes, hurricanes, acts of violence and more. The Evac+Sled easily moves over ANY surface, across floors, and down stairs.

  • Long pulling straps
  • Angled side board flaps
  • Secure patient safety straps
  • Adjustable pillow
  • Glide-able plastic board
  • No installation necessary, ready to use instantly
  • No belay system required
  • No dangerous ropes to negotiate during evacuation
  • Weight capacity 440 lbs
  • 2 person operation
  • Can be moved easily over virtually any surface
  • Narrow width and flexibility
  • Wipe clean storage bag
  • 2 year manufacturers warranty

The Evac+Sled is the ONLY transport sled that easily adapts to the passenger’s size (one size fits ALL). Its soft-absorbing head pillow reduces head movement going down stairs. About Evac+Chair of North America
EVAC+CHAIR is the original Emergency Evacuation Staircase Chair. It is simple to use, lightweight and easy to deploy and maneuver. Emergency evacuation equipment and stair transport chairs are critical in emergency situations for people with disabilities. Wall-mounted and discreet, evacuation chairs are ideal for use in office buildings, hotels, hospitals, skyscrapers and high-rise buildings. Ask about their lifetime warranty.
